statement: The table shows the number of students enrolled in a coding club at the start of each school year. $$\begin{array}{c|c} \text{Year} & \text{Students} \\ \hline 2023 & 240 \\ 2024 & 276 \\ 2025 & 306 \end{array}$$ To the nearest tenth of a percent, what was the percent increase in enrollment from 2024 to 2025?

choices.misconception: I divided the increase of 30 students by the 2025 enrollment, 306, instead of the 2024 enrollment.
I found the increase of 30 from 2024 to 2025 correctly but divided it by the 2023 enrollment, 240.
I used the change from 2023 to 2025, 66 students, and divided by 240, so I measured the wrong pair of years.

hints: Which year gives the starting value for this percent change?
Subtract the 2024 enrollment from the 2025 enrollment, then divide by the 2024 enrollment.
The increase is $306 - 276 = 30$ students, and you need $\dfrac{30}{276}$ written as a percent.

solutions.reliable: From 2024 to 2025, enrollment rose by $306 - 276 = 30$ students. The percent increase is $\dfrac{30}{276} \approx 0.10870$, or about $10.9\%$. The idea: percent change is the change divided by the value at the start of the period you are asked about.

author: Devansh Sanghavi
